items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: James was with us. Curtis Oliver.

ctx.x: him over to Mrs. Young's show. Then, when we stayed on that show, well, we got about three or four more guys in the band. James was with us. Curtis Oliver. Anyway, we had trombone and two saxophones, and trumpet. So we rehearsed on the show, while we was traveling. He was getting this band together. And he booked a dance in Minneapolis. Well, we went there and played the dance, and we stayed in Minneapolis. We stayed in Minneapolis all that winter, up until the next spring. We was headquarterin' out if there, He…
